fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Butts a target at or below 30% health for 16 damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, and 60% more damage for each one consumed. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Wearing Down
fusions.desc: Closes on a target up to 5 tiles away and deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from the full 5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every tenth of its stamina the target still has (max 25%).

fusions.name: Downwind Stalk
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds: enemies notice you 50% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Final Stretch
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
